meta.title: Channels
meta.description: Benefits and support compared across the Shared, Dedicated and Enterprise channels.

hero.title: Channels
hero.subtitle: Every API key is bound to a channel. Channels differ in capacity and support.

items.q1: How do the three channels differ?
items.a1: Shared runs on capacity shared by many users, for individual development and everyday calls. Dedicated runs on our own pool with high availability, low latency and full-strength models, for teams and production. Enterprise is set up for a single company, with custom security protection, enterprise management features and a dedicated account manager.
items.q2: Can one account use multiple channels?
items.a2: Yes. Each API key is bound to one channel, and one account can create multiple keys for different purposes.
items.a3: Price changes are announced on the pricing page in advance; consumption already incurred is not affected.
items.q4: Can organization members choose their own channel?
items.a4: Members can only create keys within the channels available to their organization.
items.q5: How do I get the Enterprise channel?
items.a5: Contact support — capacity and pricing are set by contract.
